fact: Writing in the JLOS Bulletin of May 2024, a Senior Superintendent of the Uganda Police Force's ICT Directorate says the force embarked in October 2022 on the Electronic Policing Information System (ePIS) Project, premised on automating policing business processes, and the head of the CID's legal department says ePIS 'seeks to' automate case management processes across the force and share data with the ODPP, Judiciary and Prisons and has been endorsed by the Inspector General and all heads of directorates; both describe it as a project under way, and the bulletin lists lack of internet connectivity at upcountry police stations among the sector's obstacles.
title: The JLOS Bulletin, Special Edition on E-Justice: A Digital Justice Ecosystem Promoting Social-Economic Transformation
publisher: Justice, Law and Order Sector (JLOS) Secretariat
